name: Monitor weather and alerts
description: Watch trusted forecasts and local alerts, then share only relevant timing with the group.
notes: REM should complement, not replace, official alerts.

name: Secure outdoor items
description: Bring in or tie down furniture, tools, bins, branches, and other items that may become hazards.
notes: Do this before winds or lightning make it unsafe.

name: Charge devices
description: Charge phones, REM devices, radios, lights, laptops, and battery banks.

name: Check battery banks
description: Verify battery banks, cables, adapters, and solar/generator backup if used.

name: Check sump pump
description: Confirm sump pump, backup pump, battery, discharge path, and water alarms are ready.

name: Clear drains and gutters
description: Clear leaves and debris where safe to reduce water intrusion risk.
notes: Do not climb ladders in unsafe conditions.

name: Prepare safe room
description: Move water, food, first aid, lights, blankets, chargers, and radio/REM gear into safe area.

name: Move vehicles
description: Move vehicles away from trees, low areas, or flood-prone locations if safe.

name: Notify readiness
description: Send readiness status to household or trusted circle when prep is complete or if help is needed.

name: Monitor during storm
description: Track leaks, flooding, injuries, power loss, and communications status during scheduled check-ins.
notes: Stay away from windows and floodwater.

name: Post-storm hazard check
description: Check for downed lines, structural damage, gas smell, flooding, blocked roads, and neighbor needs.
